description: This file declares functions and constants for Linux network interface utilities, including interface state management, MAC address handling, link status, VLAN and bridge checks, and vendor information.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getNetSock
methods.description: Returns a socket file descriptor to the kernel for network operations.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getState
methods.description: Checks whether a specified network interface is up or down using a socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getStateExt
methods.description: Checks whether a specified network interface is up or down without requiring a socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_setState
methods.description: Sets the operational state (up or down) of a network interface using a socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_setStateExt
methods.description: Sets the operational state of a network interface without requiring a socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_setMac
methods.description: Sets the hardware MAC address of a network interface using a socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_setMacExt
methods.description: Sets the hardware MAC address of a network interface without requiring a socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getMac
methods.description: Retrieves the hardware MAC address of a network interface using a socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getMacExt
methods.description: Retrieves the hardware MAC address of a network interface without requiring a socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getLinkState
methods.description: Checks whether the physical link of a network interface is up or down using a socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getLinkStateExt
methods.description: Checks whether the physical link of a network interface is up or down without requiring a socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getIfIndex
methods.description: Gets the netdev index of a network interface using a socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getIfIndexExt
methods.description: Gets the netdev index of a network interface without requiring a socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_updateMac
methods.description: Updates the MAC address of a network interface and toggles it if needed, using a socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_updateMacExt
methods.description: Updates the MAC address of a network interface and toggles it if needed, without requiring a socket.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getChipsetVendor
methods.description: Returns the vendor name of the chipset for a given radio name.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_isVlanIface
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is a VLAN interface by inspecting /proc/net/vlan.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getLowerIfaces
methods.description: Retrieves all lower interfaces of a given network interface from sysfs.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_getVlanLowerIface
methods.description: Retrieves the lower interface of a VLAN network interface from sysfs.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfUtils_inBridge
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is part of a bridge.
